probability_calibration.method: sigmoid calibration with chronological TimeSeriesSplit within training folds when sufficient samples exist
probability_calibration.note: Calibration metrics are measured on held-out chronological test folds; small training folds use uncalibrated model probabilities and must not be treated as calibrated.

cost_assumption.includes: user-configured aggregate per-side cost proxy only
cost_assumption.excludes: exact broker brokerage, STT, exchange transaction charges, GST, SEBI fees, stamp duty, bid-ask spread, market impact, latency and slippage unless reflected in the user's cost_bps
cost_assumption.note: Set cost_bps conservatively for research; this is not a full Indian transaction-cost calculator.

demo_trading_gate.reason: Research endpoint never enables demo trading. Gate implementation requires positive net performance across at least 3 folds, calibrated probability error thresholds, adequate trade count and persistent outcome monitoring.

evaluation.method: Expanding-window walk-forward; no shuffle; 4-row purge for next-close entry and 3-bar hold; preprocessing/calibration fit within training data; final four unlabeled bars excluded. Fold trading returns use non-overlapping windows and compound equity.
evaluation.baseline_method: Majority class and constant training-prevalence probability are recomputed independently from each fold training segment; test labels are never used to construct baselines.
limitations: No model is selected automatically from a single backtest; a good historical score is not proof of future profit.
Majority-class and constant-probability baselines are fold-specific references, not tradable strategies.
Added EMA gaps, candle body percentage and close-location features are causal and use current/past candle OHLC only.
News availability timestamps protect against historical leakage, but provider news history is limited and may leave most older candles without news features.
Demo trading remains disabled until validation checks pass and the system is explicitly reviewed; no orders are placed by this endpoint.

news_feature_status.coverage_note: No stored news records matched this exact instrument key. News features remain neutral; historical news coverage is not established.
news_feature_status.alignment: available_at <= candle timestamp; trailing 24 hours only

disclaimer: Research benchmark only. No order is placed. A validated and calibrated signal gate is not yet enabled by this endpoint.
